blender.name: Gear
blender.detail: wooden crates with rope handles, ammo boxes, hard cases, an olive footlocker, the carry case with its hinged lid, sandbags, barrels, jerrycans, a helmet with goggles, a field radio, a toy party timer, a stylised generic rifle, smoke, party and flash grenades — all original, not modelled on any game assets

blender.name: Courtyard
blender.detail: the two-tier birthday cake, brass lanterns, date palms, the photo pallet, presents, a potted shrub and a party hat

original: Made for this project, with its own look (inspired by the general mood of tactical shooters, copying none of their assets, logos, maps or sounds): the sandstone courtyard, gate, watchtower and desert town, the golden-hour sky that falls into dusk, toon shading with ink outlines, the bullet-hole name writing, the case-opening reel and its cards, the polaroid board, the party timer and its display, the radio, the grenade salute with coloured smoke and the flash afterimage, the scope and the MVP card, banners, stencils, chalkboard, string lights, fireworks, confetti and all synthesised sounds and music.
